final: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), above_mean AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate, avg_fee_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) FROM pair_averages) AS excess FROM pair_averages WHERE avg_fee_rate > (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) FROM pair_averages)), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink) AS pair_rank FROM above_mean) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate, excess, pair_rank FROM ranked WHERE pair_rank <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, pair_rank
